gen-audiowide-gf-headland-one: Futuristic tiles of Audiowide stand over a dignified, traditional voice. Headland One, a text serif whose strokes swell gently and whose letters sit well apart, offsets the heading's unvarying line.
gen-audiowide-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Audiowide keeps its lines unvarying and tile-like, a futuristic header sitting above the sturdy, classic Hedvig Letters Serif. Page after page, its open curves and moderate contrast should read comfortably.
gen-audiowide-gf-marcellus-sc: Audiowide holds its line width through every turn, giving a futuristic, tile-like headline with generous gaps between glyphs. Audiowide brings the shock; Marcellus SC brings the literary, gently modulated finish.
gen-audiowide-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab is a refined, traditional serif, its sizable x-height paired with a quiet contrast between strokes. And Audiowide, with round letters whose rims match their stems, supplies the futuristic jolt.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Tile-like glyphs and unvarying joins give Audiowide a futuristic stamp. Noto Serif Hentaigana, a text serif whose strokes thicken and thin in moderation, brings the refined, traditional counterweight.
gen-audiowide-gf-ovo: Classic and authoritative, Ovo is a serif with curves like a reed pen, set beneath the constant-weight tubes of Audiowide. One draws a line that never varies; the other thickens slightly.
gen-comfortaa-fs-sentient: Comfortaa bends glass-tube strokes into friendly, geometric letters, its c drawn as a generous ring. But Sentient, a sophisticated text serif of pinched apertures and subdued contrast, tightens things back up.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-bespoke-s: Alien Encounters feels otherworldly, with big gaps between letter pairs and a pronounced high x-height. Bespoke Slab, a grounded, refined serif, anchors it with tall bodies in every lowercase form.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-erode: Editorial and dignified, with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight, the body text sits beneath Alien Encounters. Erode keeps hairlines present but not razor thin, so paragraphs should read with ease.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-hoover: Alien Encounters brings technological flair, with big gaps between letter pairs. Hoover, refined and robust, handles the steadier work, with a generous entry into the e's eye and compressed ascenders.
